name: amazon-ads-budget-pacing
description: Use for "am I on track with my Amazon Ads budget", "will I overspend on Amazon this month", "which Amazon campaigns run out of budget", "how much should I spend a day on Amazon Ads", "we underspent on Amazon and I don't know why", "is my Amazon portfolio budget capping me", or a mid-month Amazon Ads spend check — even when the user never says "pacing". Also use when someone needs to know whether more budget on an Amazon campaign would earn it back. Amazon Ads only.
